rules.title: gofmt and go vet
rules.text: Format with gofmt and keep go vet and staticcheck clean.

rules.title: Wrap errors
rules.text: Return errors, wrap them with fmt.Errorf("...: %w", err) and check them with errors.Is and errors.As.

rules.title: Pass context
rules.text: Pass context.Context explicitly as the first parameter of functions that do I/O, and never store it in a struct.

rules.title: Small interfaces
rules.text: Define small interfaces at the consumer side; accept interfaces, return structs.

rules.title: Table-driven tests
rules.text: Write table-driven tests with t.Run subtests.

rules.title: Own goroutine lifetimes
rules.text: Never start a goroutine without a clear way for it to stop.

rules.title: Generated Go files
rules.text: Never hand-edit generated Go files such as zz_generated.* or *.pb.go. Regenerate them with the project make target.

rules.title: Package names
rules.text: Name packages in lowercase, a single word, matching the directory.

rules.title: Error strings
rules.text: Write error strings in lowercase without trailing punctuation, saying what failed and with which input.

rules.title: golangci-lint in CI
rules.text: Run golangci-lint with a committed config in CI.
